item.tib: gsang sngags zab mo mdos kyi cha lag spyi ru 'gro ba'i smad las 'jug chog
item.coloph: de ltar gsang sngags zab mo rnam bzhi las/ gang sgrub mdos kyi cha lag smad chog 'di/ spyi spungs bon la rgya che mtha' yas kyang / rang 'dra blo chung rmongs pas mi phyed pas/ nyung la 'dus pa drag po skor gsum 'di/ mtshungs med bru btsun bsod nams blo gros kyis/ zur du bkod pa'i dge legs mtha' rgyas shing*/ rnam mkhyen bla med 'bras bu myur thob shog/
